sections.text: Item #1: Scientists were able to grow perfect blood vessels in a petri dish from stem cells.[1]Item #2: Researchers identified only the second ever recorded set of semi-identical twins – a boy and girl that are half identical.[2]Item #3: A new reconstruction of a Neanderthal pelvis indicates that they did have a posture that was stooped forward when compared to modern humans.[3]
